column1: # /Graph Type Features — slice C2 of GRAPH_PLAN.md.

# Y-Ranges  {Graph|A-F|Quit} — reassign back to the first.
# Default: every series on first y-axis ("Y" not "2Y").
# /GTFYA — series A back to first y-axis.
# /GTFYG — every series back to first y-axis.
# (The panel header "Y/2Y" contains the substring "2Y", so per-row
# checks are required rather than a bare ASSERT_SCREEN_NOT_CONTAINS.)
# Frame defaults to all four sides on.
